name: vaultcraft
description: Turns lecture slides, labs, meeting notes and papers into an exam-ready, linked Obsidian vault: atomic notes with hover definitions, embedded slides, comparison tables and cross-course bridges.

interface.longDescription: vaultcraft reads your lecture slides, lab notebooks, meeting notes or papers and builds an Obsidian vault from them: one note per concept with a hover-visible definition, lecture sheets with exam questions, embedded source slides, comparison tables and a map of content. It asks a few questions first (vault type, format, depth, language), then writes the vault to your disk, or hands you a zip to open in Obsidian.
defaultPrompt: Build an Obsidian study vault from these lecture slides
Add this new lab to my existing Obsidian vault
